tour.canvas_text:
Draw right on the screenshot. The object you just drew stays selected: you can move it, drag the white handles, change its color and thickness.

Right-click an object for a menu (color, fill, duplicate, bring to front, delete). Double-click text to edit it. Delete: remove. Esc: deselect.
tour.capture_text:
{hotkey} in any program: the screen freezes, select an area with the mouse, and it opens here. A simple click without selecting captures the whole monitor, Esc cancels.

You can change {hotkey} to any shortcut you like in settings; the button below opens them right away.

Next time you press {hotkey}, the previous area is highlighted: Enter or a click inside captures the same spot.

The ClipSD icon in the tray near the clock: right-click opens a menu where you can repeat this tour.
tour.color_text:
The color for new marks. “+” opens the color picker.

If an object on the screenshot is selected, the button changes the color of that object only; the default color for new marks stays the same.
tour.done_text: “Copy” (Enter or Ctrl+C) puts the annotated screenshot on the clipboard and keeps the window open. “Copy and close” (Ctrl+Enter) does the same and closes the window. Then paste the screenshot into a messaging app or document. “Save” (Ctrl+S) saves the screenshot as a PNG or JPEG file.
tour.help_text:
The “?” button (or F1) starts this tour again.

The gear opens settings: hotkeys, screenshot folder and format, magnifier, window colors and frame thickness, autostart. Quick access: Ctrl+comma.
tour.intro_text:
ClipSD takes a screenshot and opens it here right away so you can mark what matters: arrows, frames, numbers, captions. I will show you where everything is. It takes a minute.

To move on: “Next” or the arrow keys. To close: Esc or “Skip”.
tour.lang_text: Choose a language. You can change it at any time using the globe icon in the editor, the tray icon menu, or Settings.
tour.sizes_text: Line thickness and text size, keys 1-5. For a selected object you can also change the thickness with the mouse wheel. When the eraser is selected, these buttons set its brush size.
tour.text_color_text: The color of the digit in a number and of the text in a callout. “Auto” picks white or black to suit the fill color.
tour.tools_text:
Left to right: select, callout, text, number, arrows (plain, double-ended, freehand), smooth line, line, rectangle, ellipse, freehand shape, marker, pencil, blur, eraser, crop. Each tool has a single-letter shortcut shown in its tooltip.

You can reorder the buttons: grab one with the mouse and drag it to a new place. Right-click the row to restore the default order.
tour.undo_text:
The back and forward arrows undo and redo (Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y).

The picture button places another image on top of the screenshot: from the clipboard (Ctrl+V), from a file, or a new capture of a screen area. You can also drag a file into the window.
